items.question: How do I apply for a new water connection?
items.answer: Visit the Services page for the full requirements checklist, or contact the CWD office with a valid ID and proof of property or lot rights to start an application.

items.question: Where can I pay my water bill?
items.answer: Payment options can change. Check the Payments page for currently listed methods, or contact CWD to confirm an authorized channel before paying.

items.question: What happens if I pay late?
items.answer: Late-payment charges should be confirmed against the current approved schedule. Please contact CWD or check the Rates & Fees page before relying on a penalty amount.

items.question: How do I report a leak?
items.answer: Contact the office through the Contact page and provide the location of the leak so it can be referred for assessment.

items.question: My meter reading looks wrong. What do I do?
items.answer: You may request a meter accuracy test through the Services page or by contacting the office directly.

items.question: Does CWD serve areas outside Camiling proper?
items.answer: Check the current service-area list on the About Us page and contact CWD to confirm coverage for a specific address.
